output.summary: A local-first tool is feasible with an embedded database and a thin sync layer deferred to a later slice.

findings.title: Sync ambiguity
findings.body: The brief does not define conflict resolution when two devices edit offline. Building sync before the local store is settled risks a rewrite.

findings.title: Single file store
findings.body: SQLite keeps the deployment story simple and the data inspectable.

findings.title: Export volume
findings.body: CSV export size limits are unstated; streaming export avoids memory issues.

output.recommendation: Build the local store first; treat sync as a separate, later slice.
open_questions: Which devices must sync, if any?

psd_contributions.content: Conflict resolution for offline edits is undefined (Software Architect).
